name: Raspberry Cream Cheese Pinwheel Bento Box with Sugar Snap Peas, Peanut Butter Pretzels & Cheese

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Wash, dry, and place sugar snap peas in the medium compartment of the bento box.
Place cheese and peanut butter filled pretzels each in their own small compartments of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 round mini babybel cheese
43 g peanut butter filled pretzels

instructions.primary_message: Place lavash bread (about 8 x 10-inches in size) on a flat surface. Spread cream cheese over the bread in an even layer, making sure to spread it out to the edges.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (8 x 10-inch) piece lavash bread
¼ (227 g) block cream cheese

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry raspberries. Cut raspberries in half lengthwise, then arrange over the cream cheese in an even layer. Drizzle with honey.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (170 g) pkg raspberries
2 tsp honey

instructions.primary_message: With the short edge of the lavash facing towards you, tightly roll the bread into a cylinder. Slice bread crosswise into 6 even pieces and place in the large compartment of the bento box.
Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
